pages.title: Server folders
pages.description: The server's drives and usual folders, and what each folder holds, opened with ?name=<a folder's path>: folders open their own page, Up goes to the folder above. For administrators, on every app and TV. Read-only.

props.emptyText: Nothing here, or the server isn't allowed to open this folder.

props.text: Only an administrator can look through the server's folders.
Read-only: nothing on the server can be changed from here. Add a folder to a library in Settings, Libraries.

presets.label: Server drives and space
presets.description: A row of the server's drives and usual folders, with the space left on each. Only administrators see it.

sources.label: The server's drives and folders
sources.description: The drives and usual folders on the server, each with the space left, opening the folder. Answered for administrators only; empty for anyone else.
sources.title: Server folders

sources.label: A folder on the server
sources.description: One folder on the server: the way up, then its folders, each opening its own page, then its files with their sizes. Read-only. With no path, the drives and usual folders. Answered for administrators only; empty for anyone else.

params.name: path
params.label: Folder
params.help: The folder's full path on the server, $name on the folder page. Empty: the drives and usual folders.
